## Technical analysis (Friday July 3, 2026 — US holiday, no session)

**No SPCX session today.** US markets closed for observed Independence Day (July 4 falls on Saturday 2026 → Friday July 3 is the observed closure per NYSE/NASDAQ holiday calendar). Last reference: $156.46 (July 2 AH, -0.69% from $157.54 official close).

**Step aside UNCHANGED. Framework summary:**

Bond distribution: Day 8 complete (~52M shares, est.); Day 9 paused (July 3 holiday); resumes July 6. Clearance est. Day 11–12 (July 8–9). Re-entry gate: $185 (two consecutive closes) after clearance. $156.46 is $28.54 (−15.4%) below re-entry gate.

**Holiday gap risk assessment (post-holiday):** The primary tail risk identified on July 2 — Korea-shock contagion testing the $150 IG floor during the unmanageable holiday gap — has been substantially reduced by the July 3 Asian market session. KOSPI recovered +5.76% to 8,088.34 with a buy-side VI sidecar, and SK Hynix reversed +10.88% with Stop Day 1 isolated. The Korea-driven selloff that drove SPCX to $156.16 on July 2 is not continuing into the holiday gap. July 6 US open is expected to start at $157–$162 range, maintaining the $6–12 IG floor buffer.

**Inclusion mechanics (T+2 sessions):** July 7 Day 10 Nasdaq 100 effective inclusion arrives in two trading sessions. Key expectations from the Russell 1000 June 26 (Day 4) template: (1) intraday spike to $165–$180 range from QQQ/QQQM rebalancing; (2) distribution sellers absorb the spike same session; (3) close at or below July 2's $157.54, continuing the distribution downtrend. Traders anticipating an inclusion-driven breakout above $185 are trading against a known template — DO NOT re-enter on the spike.

**Volume clearance math:** If Day 9 (July 6) = 25M shares and Day 10 (July 7) = 12M + $4.3B passive (mechanically absorbed), then Day 11 (July 8) must demonstrate <5M shares for clearance confirmation. The declining trend (126.91M → 110M → 70M → 82.05M → 52M est.) has a remaining 40–47M shares of distribution volume to work off before reaching the 5M/day threshold — at the current pace, this requires approximately 2–3 more sessions post-Day 10.

**Re-entry setup (forward-looking):** The optimal re-entry is: (1) volume <5M/day for 2–3 sessions (est. July 8–9); (2) THEN two consecutive CLOSES above $185; (3) THEN entry at $185–$195 with stop below $175; (4) target: September 2 earnings beat ($200–$225 range). This is the plan. No other entry is acceptable under the current framework.
